text:
Lena (Finance): Alert: invoice INV-2350 shows a $9,200 burst line for customer OrbitAI during scheduled maintenance window on 2026-07-20. Customer claims the workload was automatically retried onto hosted; they say it's an internal failover and want the burst removed.

Omar (Acct Mgmt): Which commit and window? Need job_ids to correlate.

Lena (Finance): Commit: 80k GPU-hours reserved. Burst = $9,200. Maintenance window 2026-07-20 01:00-03:00 UTC.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2350 posted for orbitai on 2026-07-22. Total due: $62,140. Burst line: $9,200.

Gabe (Billing): Pulling meter logs now. If hosted usage matches the same job_ids that were marked active in dedicated pool, it's double charging.

Priya (Platform): We had a controller handoff at 2026-07-20T01:32Z in zone eu-west-1 causing rehome. The retry logic didn't surface dedupe metadata to the metering agent. INF-1490 created. I can export job_id mapping.

Omar (Acct Mgmt): Customer expects either full refund or a credit and an incident report. What's our threshold for refund?

Gabe (Billing): Refunds > $5k need finance approval. Credits are easier to apply but customer prefers cash.

Lena (Finance): I can approve up to $10k cash refund for confirmed platform faults. Let's require job-level reconciliation first.

Priya (Platform): I'll attach the deduped job list to BLG-972 by EOD and mark events flagged as duplicated by the metrics agent.

Gabe (Billing): Proposal: place INV-2350 on hold, create credit memo CM-512 for $9,200, and tentatively create refund request if OrbitAI insists on cash. Hold collections until BLG-972 reconciliation.

Omar (Acct Mgmt): I'll message OrbitAI with a short note: "We are investigating, collections on INV-2350 are paused; will follow up with credit/refund after reconciliation."

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-972: "orbitai-inv2350-dedup-reconcile".

Priya (Platform): Note: some retries were legitimate (user retried jobs). Reconciliation will subtract only platform-generated duplicate events.

Lena (Finance): Action items: 1) Priya attach deduped export to BLG-972; 2) Gabe draft CM-512 and refund request; 3) Omar send customer note. Deadline: 2026-07-24.

Gabe (Billing): Will draft CM-512 and post the provisional amount. If BLG-972 confirms platform duplication = $9,200, proceed with cash refund; if only partial, we apply proportional credit.

Omar (Acct Mgmt): OrbitAI replied: appreciate the hold and want the incident report once complete.

Lena (Finance): Marking INV-2350 as "on hold - dedupe investigation" in billing queue. Will update when BLG-972 closes.
